title: Meter Operations Standard: Usual Water Usage in Leak Review — Seasonal and Recent Methods
content:
# Usual Water Usage in Leak Review — Utility Services Program

**Standard.** The usual water usage of a leak adjustment on a Utility Services Program account follows the season when the account's history allows it. Last year's water read of the same service month is the actual water read dated at least twelve and fewer than thirteen whole months before the decision date.

1. **Seasonal blend.** When the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 36 whole months before the decision date, last year's water read of the same service month exists and at least 6 actual water reads other than the disputed read are dated fewer than seven whole months before it, the usual water usage is the mean of two figures, rounded to 3 decimals: the seven-month usual usage — the usage of those seven-month reads less the usage billed on the disputed line, divided by their number less one, rounded to 3 decimals — and last year's water read of the same service month.
2. **Same-month comparison.** When the move-in date lies at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before the decision date and last year's water read of the same service month exists, the usual water usage is last year's water read of the same service month, rounded to 3 decimals.
3. **Recent mean.** In every other situation it is the four-month figure: the usage of the actual water reads dated fewer than four whole months before the decision date less the usage billed on the disputed line, divided by the number of those reads less one, rounded to 3 decimals.

Each sum of recorded water usage is taken to 2 decimals.

## Decision grid

| Whole months since move-in | Last year's same-month read | Other actual reads in seven months | Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | exists | 6 or more | seasonal blend |
| 36 or more | exists | 5 or fewer | recent mean |
| 12 to 35 | exists | any | same-month comparison |
| any | none | any | recent mean |
| fewer than 12 | exists | any | recent mean |

## Worked case (hypothetical, move-in 40 months ago)

Seven actual water reads in seven months total 26.30 thousand gallons including the disputed 12.30; last year's same-month read is 3.401.

- Seven-month usual usage: 26.30 less 12.30 is 14.00, divided by 6 is 2.333.
- Usual water usage: the mean of 2.333 and 3.401 is 2.867.
